name: help99-dev start
stdout:
Usage: bab dev start [OPTIONS]                                                                   
                                                                                                   
  Submit a detached dev job. Flags override the [dev] config (bab config show).                    
                                                                                                   
  Options                                                                                          
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  
  -p   --partition       TEXT                 partition, or auto for Slurm's default               
                                              [default=gpu]                                        
  -t   --time            TEXT                 Slurm time limit [default=08:00:00]                  
  -g   --gpu             INTEGER              GPUs to request [default=(1 on GPU partitions, else  
                                              0)]                                                  
       --gpu-type        TEXT                 GPU type, e.g. a5000 [default=(any)]                 
  -c   --cpus            INTEGER              CPUs to request [default=2]                          
  -m   --mem             TEXT                 memory to request [default=8G]                       
       --account         TEXT                 Slurm account                                        
       --constraint      TEXT                 Slurm node feature constraint (prefer --gpu-type)    
       --exclude         TEXT                 comma-separated nodes to exclude                     
  -n   --node            TEXT                 request a specific node                              
       --replace                              cancel existing dev jobs first                       
       --no-wait                              return right after submitting (not with --login)     
       --login                                open a shell once the job is RUNNING (not with       
                                              --no-wait)                                           
       --timeout         INTEGER              max seconds to wait for RUNNING                      
       --poll-interval   FLOAT RANGE [x>=1]   seconds between checks while waiting [default=5.0]   
  -h   --help                                 Show this message and exit.

name: help99-why
stdout:

  -h   --help                           Show this message and exit.

_bab_completion() {
    local IFS=$'\n'
    local response

    response=$(env COMP_WORDS="${COMP_WORDS[*]}" COMP_CWORD=$COMP_CWORD _BAB_COMPLETE=bash_complete $1)

    for completion in $response; do
        IFS=',' read type value <<< "$completion"

        if [[ $type == 'dir' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o dirnames
        elif [[ $type == 'file' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o default
        elif [[ $type == 'plain' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY+=($value)
        fi
    done

    return 0
}

_bab_completion_setup() {
    complete -o nosort -F _bab_completion bab
}

_bab_completion_setup;

#compdef bab

_bab_completion() {
    local -a completions
    local -a completions_with_descriptions
    local -a response
    (( ! $+commands[bab] )) && return 1

    response=("${(@f)$(env COMP_WORDS="${words[*]}" COMP_CWORD=$((CURRENT-1)) _BAB_COMPLETE=zsh_complete bab)}")

    for type key descr in ${response}; do
        if [[ "$type" == "plain" ]]; then
            if [[ "$descr" == "_" ]]; then
                completions+=("$key")
            else
                completions_with_descriptions+=("$key":"$descr")
            fi
        elif [[ "$type" == "dir" ]]; then
            _path_files -/
        elif [[ "$type" == "file" ]]; then
            _path_files -f
        fi
    done

    if [ -n "$completions_with_descriptions" ]; then
        _describe -V unsorted completions_with_descriptions -U
    fi

    if [ -n "$completions" ]; then
        compadd -U -V unsorted -a completions
    fi
}

if [[ $zsh_eval_context[-1] == loadautofunc ]]; then
    # autoload from fpath, call function directly
    _bab_completion "$@"
else
    # eval/source/. command, register function for later
    compdef _bab_completion bab
fi
